E-Sys MAX 5.2.6

Improved
- Cloud backup copy: a full backup is copied to your cloud folder once it has finished, so a finished backup always shows as finished there.
- Car report: a step the car refused is never listed as done.
- Updates tidy up after themselves.

Includes everything in 5.2.5: Russian language (beta), safety settings ask first, fault scan and service reset fixes.

Your licence and settings stay the same after updating.

Thank you for using E-Sys MAX.
